<!-- pr-reviewer: 43943371af5f59bdbfdaf4e9722ac314af06a489 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- `ok` only gains an extra `&& held_by.is_empty()` conjunct (`crates/app/src/script/api.rs` `v_verify`), so it can only get stricter: nothing that was `ok: false` before can become `true`. The gate, freshness check and findings list are untouched.
- `holds_post` mirrors the post's own rule: suppressed ops are skipped (`posting.rs:497-507`) and only `blocks_post()` warnings become WARN records (`posting.rs:854`). Scallop/probe notes stay notes.
- Typings (`cam.d.ts` + template in `script/mod.rs`), MCP tool description and a decision record are all updated. Body ends `Fixes #722`, has a `Changelog:` line. No snapshot, golden, dependency, build.rs, script or .github changes. No unwrap/panic added.
- The three pinning tests cover the held, clean and CLI-exit cases.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main; trial merge clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_verify` | 3 passed |
| `scripting` (incl. bindings drift) | 18 passed |
| `mcp` | 13 passed |
| `mcp_live` | 10 passed |
| `mcp_setup` | 6 passed |
| `cli` | 7 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Intended behaviour change: `camcraft-cli process` without `-o` now exits 1 for jobs whose ops' warnings refuse the post.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
